summary: ITER161 P0.1+P0.2 backend+frontend tested. Found CRITICAL syntax error in client_provisioning.py blocking ALL ITER161 flows (silent-magic-link 500, journey provisioning returning null fields). Fixed the stray garbage at lines 506-508. After fix, all 10/11 backend tests pass (1 skipped). Frontend: silent magic-link toggle, client→/client redirect, open-redirect block, welcome panel, recall modal all work. Welcome panel missing data-testid='client-welcome-cta-continue' (1 of 3 required CTAs).

critical.issue: Stray corrupted text 'n("silent_magic_link email failed")\n\n    return True' after the proper return True caused IndentationError at module import. This broke ALL ITER161 endpoints that call into client_provisioning: silent-magic-link returned 500, journeys/initiate provisioning silently failed (magic_link_url/profile_id/thread_id/assignee all null). FIXED by testing agent (removed stray block).

critical_code_review_comments: client_provisioning.py had a stray garbage block after the final 'return True' — clearly a bad merge/paste. This is a class of bug (orphan code after function returns) that a Python pre-commit (ruff/syntax check) would catch instantly. Recommend adding `python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(...)'` or ruff to pre-commit/CI before deploy.

All ITER161 endpoints depend on client_provisioning import succeeding. The router code catches the exception per-request (good) but on import failure NOTHING in the dependent flow works. Backend smoke-test claimed in the agent_to_agent_context_note did NOT cover this case — recommend adding a startup self-test that asserts critical modules import.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA: client_provisioning.py had corrupt trailing bytes (`n("silent_magic_link email failed")\n\n    return True`) after the legitimate `return True` on line 505. Python raised IndentationError at import. Because services/client_provisioning is imported by routers/auth.py (silent_magic_link_endpoint), routers/journey_initiate.py (provisioning call), and others, every dependent endpoint failed: silent-magic-link → 500, journeys/initiate succeeded at the journey-creation layer but the try/except around `provision_client_after_journey` swallowed the ImportError and returned the response envelope with all provisioning fields = null. Reproduction: GET any module path that imports client_provisioning before fix → IndentationError visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Mitigation: removed the 3 stray lines; backend restarted cleanly; all 10 tests now pass.
